2609.40111.title: Agent Error Dataset: Scaling 50,000 Error--Diagnosis Pairs for Failure Analysis and Error-Aware Post-Training
2609.40111.paper_summary: An unsuccessful LLM agent rollout contains more information than its final reward: the observations available to the agent, the actions it chose, and the environment's responses. Reusing this experience for learning requires identifying a decision to revise and testing a concrete alternative. We introduce the Agent Error Dataset (AED), comprising 50,228 error-diagnosis pairs from 9,961 source tasks across 33 environments, 19 harness families, and 23 policy models in text-based agent systems. We retain source traces and execution metadata to support cross-setting failure analysis and re-diagnosis without repeating the original rollout. Our five-stage Agentic Error-to-Training (AET) pipeline collects natural failures, generates diagnoses and proposed corrections, and checks them against recorded evidence. Where replay is supported, we compare corrections with original-action retries from the same checkpoint under matched execution settings. We then construct separate training views for diagnosis and actor recovery. Across 3,062 matched replay pairs, first-proposal corrections raise verifier pass rates from 18.4% to 51.1%, a gain of 32.7 percentage points. Using a separately frozen diagnosis release, full-diagnosis fine-tuning on 1,656 source tasks raises Qwen3-8B's exact-step agreement with internal teacher labels from 47.2% to 63.6%, averaged over three seeds on a 943-case holdout. The strongest prompted reference in this comparison scores 54.7%, and mean agreement improves at each of four increasing training-set sizes. In a single-seed comparison of actor-training recipes, action-only repair training scores 6.67 percentage points higher on WebShop-lite than success-only training.
2609.40111.paper_summary_zh: 一個不成功的LLM代理推出包含的信息比其最終獎勵更多：可供代理觀察的信息、它選擇的行動以及環境的反應。重用這些經驗進行學習需要識別出一個修訂的決策並測試一個具體的替代方案。我們介紹了代理錯誤數據集（AED），該數據集包含來自33個環境、19個工具家族和23個策略模型的9,961個源任務中的50,228對錯誤診斷。我們保留源痕跡和執行元數據，以支持跨設置的故障分析和重新診斷，而無需重複原始推出。我們的五階段代理錯誤到訓練（AET）流程收集自然故障，生成診斷和建議的修正，並將其與記錄的證據進行核對。在支持重播的情況下，我們將修正與來自相同檢查點的原始行動重試進行比較，並在匹配的執行設置下進行。然後，我們為診斷和行為者恢復構建單獨的訓練視圖。在3,062對匹配的重播對中，首次提議的修正將驗證者通過率從18.4%提高到51.1%，增幅為32.7個百分點。使用單獨凍結的診斷版本，對1,656個源任務進行的全診斷微調使Qwen3-8B與內部教師標籤的精確步驟一致性從47.2%提高到63.6%，在943個案例的保留集上平均三次種子。這次比較中最強的提示參考得分為54.7%，而平均一致性在四個增大的訓練集大小中逐步改善。在單一種子比較行為者訓練配方中，僅行動修復訓練在WebShop-lite上的得分比僅成功訓練高出6.67個百分點。
